title.en: Mixing seal φ65 on the Pinjin wear-part page
title.zh: 品锦易损件页上的搅拌密封 φ65

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a mixing-seal set at φ65. Generation kits on the same page have no outer diameter. No pump model or service life is printed.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械把搅拌密封套件列为 φ65。同一页的分代套件没有外径。没有印泵型号或寿命。

h1.zh: 混凝土泵搅拌密封 φ65

directAnswer.en: The φ65 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ65.
directAnswer.zh: φ65 搅拌密封是邢台搅拌密封页上的一套，用于混凝土泵和搅拌泵。请在搅拌装置上核对这一外径。页面没有写哪一台已公布搅拌泵使用 φ65。

body.en: Sizes on the page: φ65, φ80, and generation kits (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th) plus an upper-pump kit. Those generation rows and the upper-pump row do not print an extra outer diameter. This note is only φ65. Unit: set. Material and life are missing.
body.zh: 页面尺寸：φ65、φ80，以及第一代至第四代套件和上泵套件。分代行和上泵行没有另印外径。本文只写 φ65。单位：套。材料和寿命缺失。

body.en: Integrated Mixer Pump prints 45 kW / 14 kW, a 400 or 500 mixer note, and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints a 400 or 500 mixer note and no pipe diameter. Neither page names φ65 or φ80. φ65 is not repeated on the other wear-part size lists in this catalogue.
body.zh: 搅拌泵一体机印了 45 kW / 14 kW、400 或 500 搅拌的说明，以及管子 100 / 125 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机印了 400 或 500 搅拌的说明，没有管径。两页都没有写 φ65 或 φ80。 φ65 没有在本目录其他易损件尺寸清单里重复出现。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write mixing seal φ65 and the quantity in sets. Do not substitute a generation kit unless that is the row you checked.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明搅拌密封 φ65 和套数。除非核对到的就是分代那一行，否则不要改成分代套件。

question.en: Which pump model is assigned to φ65?

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

question.en: Is there a list price or a small parcel?

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp.
answer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。

question.en: Are these OEM parts of another brand?
question.zh: 这是其他品牌的原厂件吗？

answer.en: The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands.
answer.zh: 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。

question.en: Where do I send the size?

answer.en: Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 搅拌密封 page plus this size and the quantity.
answer.zh: 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明搅拌密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
